body.prompt: A bright gun muzzle flash spark: a sharp star-shaped burst of white-hot light with short radiating spikes, like a tracer round striking metal. Bold simple silhouette, high contrast, chunky shapes, isolated on a plain black background

assets.prompt: A compact, centered muzzle-flash spark in a sharp, uneven starburst silhouette. A white-hot central core transitions through flat yellow and orange bands, with short, chunky spikes radiating outward. Use bold, even dark outlines and hard-edged two-tone cel shading for a crisp, high-contrast shape. Keep the spark isolated against a plain light-gray background.

assets.prompt: A centered, slightly horizontal burst of white-hot light, with a broad angular core and several short, pointed rays extending from its sides and corners. The silhouette is chunky and immediately readable, isolated on plain light gray.
